title: Quiz: Web Performance
description: Check your understanding of Web Performance.

questions.question: Which of these is the correct way to write a comment in HTML?
questions.explanation: In HTML, <!-- --> marks a comment. Block comments use -->.

questions.question: What does loading="lazy" do on an image?
options: Defers loading until the image scrolls near the viewport
questions.correctAnswer: Defers loading until the image scrolls near the viewport
questions.explanation: Off-screen images no longer compete for bandwidth upfront.

questions.question: True or False: Setting width and height on images prevents layout shift (CLS).
Fill in the blank: <script ${attr} src="app.js"></script>  // load after parsing
questions.explanation: defer downloads in parallel but executes after HTML parses.

questions.question: In HTML, what is the safest way to predict what a program outputs?
options: Depends on the code — trace it line by line
questions.correctAnswer: Depends on the code — trace it line by line
questions.explanation: Read top to bottom, track variable values, and note every output statement.
